summary: Aureon OS is the company-built delivery system through which Aureon applies Harmonic Nexus Core research principles to source-linked, human-gated workflows. The public architecture connects provenance, review authority and bounded action across specialist applications without exposing private runtime data or claiming production readiness, safety, trading performance, customer adoption or independent validation.
technical_summary: The repository documents an evidence-heavy operating layer with explicit provenance, claim-state, review, authority and redaction boundaries. It is presented as inspectable company implementation and technical-diligence source material, separate from proof of autonomous production operation or validated sector outcomes.
